description: This file defines the 'WebMeeting' interface, which specifies methods for scheduling, managing, and retrieving details of meetings within the external API component of the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: scheduleMeeting
methods.description: Schedules a new meeting based on the provided bean object.

methods.name: unscheduleMeeting
methods.description: Unschedules or cancels a meeting associated with the provided bean object.

methods.name: inviteAttendee
methods.description: Invites an attendee to a meeting, optionally sending invites.

methods.name: uninviteAttendee
methods.description: Removes an attendee from a meeting.

methods.name: listMyMeetings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of meetings associated with the current user.

methods.name: getMeetingDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific meeting.
